why_ai: Interchange-funded card issuance persists, but the policy and coding layer is automatable software.
why_clarity: Transactions, receipts and ledger postings repeat thousands of times with clear rules.
why_digital: Virtual cards, receipts and ERP sync delivered entirely as software.

why_ai: Behavioural detection over rich transaction data automates, though insiders adapt.
why_clarity: In-policy misuse is rarely confirmed, so labels and feedback are sparse.
why_digital: Card and expense data analysed in software.

why_ai: Thin-file credit carries loss exposure and lending rules, but signals are continuous and held.
why_clarity: Limits are exact numbers, but repayment outcomes arrive months later in collections.
why_digital: Bank and cashflow data underwritten online in minutes.

why_ai: Receipt capture and requirement scoping by amount and category are fully automatable.
why_clarity: Audit and tax rules define which receipts are needed per transaction.
why_digital: Receipt images and reminders handled in apps.

why_ai: Millions of cleanly labelled approve-or-deny decisions make this supervised learning.
why_clarity: Each exception has a recorded verdict to train and test against.
why_digital: Transactions and approvals recorded entirely in the platform.

why_ai: Coding transactions to charts of accounts is a transfer learning problem.
why_clarity: Every transaction lands in one correct account, checkable at close.
why_digital: Transactions mapped into ERP systems by integration.

why_ai: Causal comparison across thousands of companies is analysis software can do.
why_clarity: What counts as a better spend outcome is undefined and effects show slowly.
why_digital: Policy configurations and spend outcomes analysed on the platform.

why_ai: Line-item spend joined to bank balances is a unique data asset AI cannot recreate.
why_clarity: Models over held data repeat, but the insight products are still undefined.
why_digital: Transaction data modelled and sold as data products.

why_ai: Static rules plus a labelled exception corpus are ready to automate.
why_clarity: Rules fire identically on every transaction, but their real effect is untested.
why_digital: Rule engines and approvals run inside software.

why_ai: The controller answers for the books, though approvals and receipt chasing automate.
why_clarity: Monthly close follows set steps and reconciles to the ledger.
why_digital: Approvals, reconciliations and reporting done on screens internally.
